summary_en: This study tests chemotherapy given before surgery for early breast cancer, with some arms adding pembrolizumab, trastuzumab and pertuzumab. It is for people with triple negative, HER2-positive, or high-risk estrogen receptor-positive invasive breast cancer. Treatment is given in 21-day or 14-day cycles, with 4 cycles of each of two drug stages (paclitaxel-based, then doxorubicin plus cyclophosphamide), and the study measures whether early tumor shrinkage predicts how much tumor remains at surgery; the record is a Phase II trial and does not state a separate formal outcome measure.
summary_es: Este estudio evalúa quimioterapia administrada antes de la cirugía para el cáncer de mama temprano, y algunos grupos añaden pembrolizumab, trastuzumab y pertuzumab. Está dirigido a personas con cáncer de mama invasivo triple negativo, HER2 positivo o con receptor de estrógeno positivo de alto riesgo. El tratamiento se administra en ciclos de 21 o 14 días, con 4 ciclos en cada una de dos etapas (una basada en paclitaxel, y luego doxorrubicina más ciclofosfamida); el estudio busca saber si la reducción temprana del tumor predice cuánto tumor queda en la cirugía, y el registro indica que es un ensayo de fase II sin una medida formal de resultado indicada por separado.
who_for: At least 18 years old and able to give informed consent
Invasive breast cancer that is triple negative, HER2-positive, or high-risk estrogen receptor-positive
Tumor at least 2 cm by exam or ultrasound
Adequate heart pumping function and blood, liver and kidney test values
not_for: Definite evidence of Stage IV disease
Prior anthracycline treatment or prior treatment for current breast cancer
Certain heart conditions that would prevent use of the study drugs
